answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 160668 Country: India Title: If gas passes while making wudhu Question: What should one do if gas passes while making wudhu or should he complete the already doing wudhu, e.g. if one is washing arms and gas passes should he repeat the wudhu or not? Answer ID: 160668 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 910/873/M=8/1439) If something happens that breaks wudhu at the time of making wudhu, for example passing wind, then it is mandatory to make wudhu afresh. If one washed one’s hands and passed wind then the previous act got annulled, thus he should start his wudhu again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
